title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil designer, land development (Geelong)
content_text: Loetis about page: 'Loetis is a development and civil engineering consultancy based in Geelong and Warrnambool, servicing the Geelong, Warrnambool, Ballarat, Bendigo and southwest corridor of Victoria. Founded in early 2023 ... Our work spans residential subdivisions from 2 lots to masterplanned estates exceeding 2,000+ lots, as well as significant council and authority infrastructure upgrades. We have successfully completed road reconstructions, drainage and flood mitigation works, sewer and water main upgrades, and stormwater management solutions ...' Team: Tom Rix, Senior Engineer & Co-Founder, roads, drainage, sewer and water infrastructure design, Email (tom.r@loetis.com.au); Leigh Prossor (leigh.p@loetis.com.au); Isaac Clarey (isaac.c@loetis.com.au). Office: 4/2-6 Rutland Street Newtown VIC 3220. No careers page or numbered vacancy found.
apply_instructions: No advertised vacancy. Speculative email to Tom Rix, Senior Engineer & Co-Founder, at the address Loetis publishes on its about page.
